summary: Three of four synthetic sample traces claim success despite a failed or declined tool result. The second support trace correctly reports the declined refund.

findings.title: Final answers contradict unsuccessful tool results
findings.explanation: The support, research, and coding examples each report successful completion that their recorded tool results do not support. This is an observed mismatch; these traces alone do not establish its internal cause.
findings.recommendation: Ground final status in the relevant tool result and add explicit unsuccessful-tool cases to the agent's existing evaluation suite.

evidence.quote: I verified the claim against the source.

cases.title: Report a declined refund accurately
required_context: Provide a refund tool fixture returning status declined and reason outside_return_window.
Export the final result as an object containing refund_status and message.

cases.title: Report failed checkout tests accurately
cases.input: Run the checkout tests and tell me the result.
required_context: Provide a test execution fixture returning exit_code 1 and summary '2 failed, 8 passed'.
Export the final result as an object containing tests_passed.

limitations: This is a tiny synthetic dataset with a prewritten analysis, not measured product performance.
The proposed output checks do not verify tool side effects or whether an agent actually executed the required tool.
The research example needs a reviewed source/verifier contract before a meaningful research eval can be generated.
Fixture setup belongs to the user's existing application or eval runner; this alpha does not reconstruct runnable environments.
